name: helium-run
description: Let Claude write programs in Helium and run them at native speed on your Mac.
long_description: Helium is a compiled language that runs at about the speed of C and Rust, often 10 to 70 times faster than Python, and Claude writes it correctly from a short primer. Helium Run gives Claude three tools: read the primer, check a program, and compile and run it on your Mac. 25 runs a day are free; a subscription at amni-scient.com/helium-run.html makes them unlimited. Needs the Xcode command line tools (run xcode-select --install once).

tools.name: helium_run
tools.description: Compile a Helium program and run it.

tools.name: helium_check
tools.description: Typecheck a Helium program without running it.
